subject: Rstudio: Code Folding and Sections website might use an update.

messages.author: 3a28b296167ce88d
messages.subject: Rstudio: Code Folding and Sections website might use an update.
parts:
Hi Joe,

On your guys Rstudio support site you have a guide called "Code Folding and Sections":
https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/200484568-Code-Folding-and-Sections

In it it says:
  • Edit -> Folding:
    • Collapse — Alt+L
    • Expand — Shift+Alt+L
    • Collapse All — Alt+A
    • Expand All — Shift+Alt+A
However, when I open up the R-studio it says "Collapse ALL Alt+O", and "Expand All Alt+Shift+O". It is also correct in the keyboard shortcut resources:
https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/200711853-Keyboard-Shortcuts

I post there here as friendly suggestion that "Code Folding and Sections" guide be updated. :)

Thanks,
Reino
